description: This file defines a UtilityScript class that provides methods for evaluating expressions, serializing values, and managing built-in browser APIs, primarily used for injected scripting in a web environment.

classes.name: UtilityScript
classes.description: A class providing utilities for evaluating expressions and handling JSON serialization in a browser context.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the global context, optionally as a function with parameters.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Serializes a value into a JSON-compatible format, with special handling for undefined.

methods.name: _promiseAwareJsonValueNoThrow
methods.description: Handles serialization of promise-like objects, ensuring proper async handling and error suppression.
